3,211 likes, 299 comments - yourfoodlab on October 10, 2026: "Today, I’m making these super delicious, thin and soft Moringa Theplas at home! 🌿❤️

And if your theplas or rotis don’t come out thin just yet, don’t stress, we’ve all been there! With a little practice, you’ll get the hang of it, trust me. 😊

What I love most about moringa is how versatile it is, there are so many delicious ways to enjoy it, and I’ll keep sharing more recipes with you. ❤️".
